⚠ Stop using this appliance
Please don't keep resetting the trip. Leave the appliance unplugged and have it checked by a qualified electrician or appliance engineer before using it again. Please stop using the microwave immediately and do not reset the fuse box again. A microwave tripping your kitchen's main supply is a serious safety hazard caused by an internal electrical fault, likely in the high-voltage components (such as the magnetron or capacitor) which store lethal charges even when unplugged. Because this involves live mains wiring and dangerous internal voltages, you cannot safely diagnose or fix this yourself. You need to call a qualified appliance engineer or electrician to inspect it. Do not attempt to open the casing or test components internally.
